output_list.criticism: The function balanceOf is a public function, anyone can call it to check the balance of any address. This could be used by malicious users to access the tokens of other users.
The function getEthBalance is a public function, anyone can call it to check the balance of any address. This could be used by malicious users to access the tokens of other users.
The function transferOwnership is a public function, anyone can call it to transfer the ownership of the contract. This could be used by malicious users to take control of the contract.
